messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: staged rollout v4.3.0 -> 4% (regions: global). Initiator: yuki. Cmd: `/deploy start --version v4.3.0 --percent 4 --note \"weighted routing + fallback rewrite\"`

yuki: launching canary now. preflight green. change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. watching p50/p99, 5xx, and routing error rates.

gabe: QA smoke passed. We added a weighted routing change to bias traffic away from legacy hosts for certain heavy requests — monitor routing mismatch metric.

qa-bot: SMOKE: basic e2e pass. Special note: synthetic long-convo probe shows slight increase in tail latencies (~60ms).

infra-bot: NOTICE: ap-east p99 +75ms (baseline +20ms) on long convos. No 5xx yet. Sampled traces point to increased connection churn on model-router-5 after routing rule change.

yuki: ok hold bumping. I'll pin ap-east region and we can decide whether to tweak weights or roll back routing only.

release-manager: Vote: HOLD for ap-east. Prefer weighted-tweak first (less blast radius). If that doesn't stabilize in 10m, prepare a routing takeover where we force 100% of traffic for the affected endpoint to v4.2.x variant.

ops-sre: +1 HOLD. Documenting rollback criteria: sustained p99 > 400ms for 3m OR 5xx > 0.4% for 2m -> rollback. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --version v4.2.8 --percent 100`. Also record routing takeover cmd: `/routing set --service generation --target v4.2.8 --percent 100 --scope ap-east`

gabe: I'll open a small weight-adjust PR to nudge the router back toward legacy hosts for heavy paths. If that fixes tails we can unpin. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/5333

infra-bot: ALERT: ap-east p99 now +110ms (3m window) and connection_retry_rate increased.

yuki: Gabe please apply the weight tweak now. If no improvement in 5m we execute routing takeover.

gabe: Applying weight tweak via config now: `/config apply --path /routing/weights/v4.3-tweak-ap-east.json --scope ap-east`

deploy-bot: Config apply recorded. Propagation ~45s.

infra-bot: NOTE: after weight tweak, p99 trending down but still elevated ~65ms. connection_retry_rate decreasing.

qa-bot: Running targeted long-convo probe post-tweak. ETA 3m.

support: Draft blurb for support: "We're investigating higher latency for some long conversations in AP-East after a platform update. Engineers are working on a mitigation; we'll update soon."

yuki: Good. Keep pin in place for ap-east. If QA probe and infra clear in 10m we can unpin and continue to 12%.

infra-bot: ALERT: ap-east p99 returned to +22ms (near baseline). No 5xx.

release-manager: Given improvements, approve unpin. Keep a contingency ready: routing takeover command staged in deploy-runbook. Postmortem owner: gabe.

deploy-bot: Unpin recorded: `/release unpin v4.3.0 --scope ap-east` executed by release-manager. Percent bumps re-enabled for that scope. Thread state: RESUMED.

yuki: Resuming rollout to 12% (ap-east). Will monitor full window. Thanks all. :tada:
